items.question: What is declared to be always the cause of all accomplishments of Sarveśvarī?
items.inference: The verse identifies the declared form as always causing all accomplishments of Sarveśvarī.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of samākhyātaḥ to the preceding context is not fully recoverable from this isolated verse.
items.plain_english: Declared as always causing all accomplishments, of Sarveśvarī.
